fusions.name: Bitter Cargo
fusions.desc: Draws the poison back out of a target up to 6 tiles away as you pass. It deals 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Urgent Dispatch
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away and vents the poison you have drawn across a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 12 damage and leaves each enemy [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: House Call
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and from each ally, and restores 10 health to you. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Clean Getaway
fusions.desc: When a condition on you ends, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.
